ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white region across both lobes; low-intensity dark border defining the trailing edge; isolated irregular dark cluster located at the medial base above the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate interior pixel angle of 78 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitudes vary from 4 to 20 pixels with greater peak density toward the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile transitioning from the lateral tips toward the central notch along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple localized low-intensity circular pixel clusters (3-10 pixels in diameter) on the white surface regions; dense, irregular high-contrast massing (encrustations) present at the extreme distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular protrusions at the lateral lobe tips consistent with parasitic or barnacle colonization; distinctive asymmetrical dark pigment marking situated centrally near the peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific geometric silhouette of the central dark pigment patch at the fluke base provides a unique visual identifier.
